# Eventify

> Eventify (https://www.eventifyafrica.co.ke) is an event ticketing and discovery platform for Kenya and South Sudan. People find events and buy tickets with M-Pesa; organizers list events for free and only pay when tickets sell.

## For people going to events

- Discover events by city (Nairobi, Juba and beyond) or by category: Corporate, Campus, Music & Arts, Workshops and Free.
- Checkout takes under a minute and is paid with M-Pesa from a phone. MTN Mobile Money and card are on the way.
- No surprise fees: the price shown is the price you pay. Free events cost nothing.
- Tickets arrive as an Express Entry Live Pass for queue-free check-in at the door. No account is needed to buy a ticket.

## For organizers

- Built for four kinds of organizer: corporate teams (conferences and launches), campus clubs and societies, independent artists (shows and listening sessions) and workshop hosts.
- Listing an event is free, with no monthly cost; Eventify takes a share of ticket sales from the payout, nothing up front.
- Every organizer gets a public profile page, a short event link and share buttons for WhatsApp, Instagram and X, plus a dashboard for sales, payouts and check-ins.
